name: Netina
source:
Pronouns: She/Her

A seemingly friendly girl who gave Nova at tour around the school. She values her popularity above all else, although she also gossips frequently about her classmates.

[spoiler]It turns out she's the one who bullies Mary, which isn't too surprising considering how she frequently refers to her as "Scary Mary."[/spoiler]
